cd /app/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, random
rng = random.Random(42)
# large graph: 12000 states, 60000 edges
N = 12000
names = ["a%d" % i for i in range(16)]
states = []
for i in range(N):
    delivered = [[] for _ in range(1)]
    # most states delivered 0 vectors (not done)
    if i % 3 == 0:
        delivered = [[[5]]]
    states.append({"delivered": delivered, "slots": []})
edges = []
used = set()
for i in range(60000):
    s = rng.randrange(N); t = rng.randrange(N); nm = names[rng.randrange(16)]
    if (s,nm,t) in used: continue
    used.add((s,nm,t)); edges.append([s,nm,t])
req = {"op":"audit","inputs":[[[5]]],"states":states,"edges":edges,"start":0,
       "fairness":[{"action":n,"mode":"weak"} for n in names[:4]]}
open("big.jsonl","w").write(json.dumps(req)+"\n")
print("written", len(edges))
PYEOF
time python3 -I /app/submission/main.py < big.jsonl | head -c 300
